item.description:
**Apple Silicon only** (M1 or newer) · **macOS 14.4+** · about **7 GB free disk** (409 MB app + 5.9 GB speech models downloaded on first run).
macOS will refuse to open it once — Leise is signed but not notarised. Go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, find the line about Leise, click **Open Anyway**. Full walkthrough, in English, Deutsch and 简体中文: [README](https://github.com/ramonfeng/leise#readme).
**Your audio and your transcripts never leave your Mac.** The app makes exactly two network requests, both named in the README and both under your control: downloading the speech models on first run, and — only if you tick the box, which is unticked by default — checking for a new version.
### Files
- `Leise-2.1.zip` — the app. - `leise-2.1-source.tar.gz` — the complete corresponding source for this exact build (GPL-3.0).
